		if [[ -n "$criteria_candidate" ]]; then
			validate_criteria_definition_file "$criteria_candidate" 2
			cmp -s "$criteria_definition" "$criteria_candidate" ||
				die 'legacy root criteria definition is immutable and cannot be replaced'
		fi
		validate_criterion_inventory "$criteria_definition" definition
	elif (( recovery_publish == 1 )); then
		[[ -n "$criteria_candidate" ]] ||
			die 'legacy recovery task requires a criteria definition TSV'
		validate_criterion_inventory "$criteria_candidate" definition
	elif [[ -n "$criteria_candidate" ]]; then
		die 'a criteria definition may be installed only by a manager recovery task'
	fi
fi

validate_decomposition_for_root()
{
	local candidate="$1" expected_parent="$2" child known
	local -A known_ids=()
	validate_criterion_decomposition_candidate "$candidate" "$expected_parent"
	while IFS= read -r known; do
		[[ -n "$known" ]] && known_ids[$known]=1
	done < <(
		task_root_declared_criteria "$root"
		[[ ! -f "$criterion_decomposition" ]] || awk -F '\t' 'NR > 1 {print $2}' "$criterion_decomposition"
	)
	while IFS=$'\t' read -r _ child _ _; do
		[[ -z "${known_ids[$child]:-}" ]] ||
			die "child criterion identifier is already used by this root: $child"
		if [[ -f "$(task_criterion_ledger_file "$root")" ]] &&
			awk -F '\t' -v item="$child" 'NR > 1 && $1 == item {found=1} END {exit !found}' \
				"$(task_criterion_ledger_file "$root")"; then
			die "child criterion identifier is already recorded in the verified-item ledger: $child"
		fi
	done < <(tail -n +2 "$candidate")
}

target_criterion=""
if (( ${#declared_criteria[@]} > 0 )) && [[ "$task_id" != "$root" ]]; then
	target_count="$(awk -F': ' '$1 == "Target-Criterion" {count++} END {print count + 0}' "$task_file")"
	(( target_count == 1 )) ||
		die 'a continuation of a criterion-decomposed root requires exactly one Target-Criterion'
	target_criterion="$(awk -F': ' '$1 == "Target-Criterion" {print $2; exit}' "$task_file")"
	first_unmet="$(task_first_unmet_criterion "$root" 2>/dev/null || true)"
	if [[ -z "$first_unmet" && -n "$criteria_candidate" && ! -f "$criteria_definition" ]]; then
		for criterion in "${declared_criteria[@]}"; do
			if ! task_criterion_is_passed "$root" "$criterion"; then
				first_unmet="$criterion"
				break
			fi
		done
	fi
	[[ -n "$first_unmet" ]] || die 'all declared root criteria are already passed; accept the root instead of publishing a continuation'
	if [[ -n "$decomposition_candidate" ]]; then
		(( recovery_publish == 1 )) ||
			die 'a child criterion decomposition may be installed only by a manager recovery task'
		[[ -z "$(task_criterion_children "$root" "$first_unmet")" ]] ||
			die "the first unmet criterion is already decomposed: $first_unmet"
		validate_decomposition_for_root "$decomposition_candidate" "$first_unmet"
		decomposed_first="$(awk -F '\t' 'NR == 2 {print $2}' "$decomposition_candidate")"
		[[ "$target_criterion" == "$decomposed_first" ]] ||
			die "continuation must target the first new child criterion: $decomposed_first"
	elif [[ "$target_criterion" != "$first_unmet" ]]; then
		die "continuation must target the first unmet criterion: $first_unmet"
	fi
elif [[ -n "$decomposition_candidate" ]]; then
	die 'child criterion decomposition requires an existing explicit criterion inventory'
fi

goal_mode=0
goal_id=""
goal_target=""
goal_success_evidence=""
goal_focused_validation=""
goal_allowed_scope=""
goal_baseline_boundary=""
goal_hard_blocks=""
if (( HARNESS_WORKER_GOAL_MODE == 1 )); then
	goal_mode=1
	[[ "$(require_single_metadata_value "$task_file" Execution-Mode 'goal-mode assignment')" == LEAF_GOAL ]] ||
		die 'goal-mode assignment must set Execution-Mode: LEAF_GOAL'
	goal_id="$(require_single_metadata_value "$task_file" Goal-ID 'goal-mode assignment')"
	validate_goal_id "$goal_id"
	goal_target="$(require_single_metadata_value "$task_file" Target-Criterion 'goal-mode assignment')"
	goal_success_evidence="$(require_single_metadata_value "$task_file" Goal-Success-Evidence 'goal-mode assignment')"
	goal_focused_validation="$(require_single_metadata_value "$task_file" Focused-Validation 'goal-mode assignment')"
	goal_allowed_scope="$(require_single_metadata_value "$task_file" Allowed-Scope 'goal-mode assignment')"
	goal_baseline_boundary="$(require_single_metadata_value "$task_file" Baseline-Boundary 'goal-mode assignment')"
